briefing.headline: The expansion stays intact as inflation eases but unemployment ticks higher.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 sits near the Fed's target, letting rates ease.
Unemployment at 4.2 percent for Sep 2026 has risen slightly, though remains consistent with steady work.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury lower, from 4.98 percent to 4.94 percent.
